homePage.faq.q1: What content can I learn with in SubStreamEdu?
homePage.faq.a1: 1. YouTube: any video or podcast by pasting a link. 2. Movies & Series: your own movie and series files (.mp4, .mkv, .srt) downloaded from torrents or anywhere, or via our Telegram bot:
homePage.faq.a1_cont: 3. Music & Songs: learn with interactive song lyrics. 4. Custom & AI Texts: type your own words and phrases, paste any text, or generate level-tailored stories with AI. 5. Subtitles as text: read full movie transcripts as clean text with drag-and-highlight lookup.
homePage.faq.a2: Easy: upload a video file (.mp4 or .mkv) with correct filename (e.g., 'The.Matrix.1999.mp4') / choose suitable subtitles from the suggested list / highlight words and phrases / save to dictionary. You can also open a YouTube video by link or upload your own subtitles.
homePage.faq.a3: Yes. Up to 100 translations, up to 50 saved words in the dictionary. After that, the system will offer a subscription. If you feel the service really boosts your English, get a subscription and learn without limits.
homePage.faq.q4: What is Active Listening Mode and default subtitle blur?
homePage.faq.a4: By default, subtitles are blurred so your brain is forced to understand native speech by ear instead of passively reading ahead. Whenever you want to verify what you heard or look up words, simply hover your cursor over the subtitle (or tap on mobile) to unblur it instantly. In player settings, you can also enable a 2-second subtitle delay (-2s).
homePage.faq.q5: What makes the Smart Dictionary special?
homePage.faq.a5: Unlike generic translators, SubStreamEdu analyzes the full sentence context to translate idioms and slang accurately. Every word is saved with audio, phonetics, and context sentence, scheduled via the scientific FSRS algorithm.
homePage.faq.a6: Your dictionary is integrated with the bot. Every morning the bot sends you words to repeat using spaced repetition. Plus quizzes, statistics, and gamification.
